records.observation: Extends clog2.InputLog and implements InputAPI. Initialization creates TopologyIterator(-1), first-category flag true. peek for -1 returns static TOPOLOGY until iterator exhausted, then constructs ContentIterator(1) and returns CATEGORY unconditionally. For IDs1/2/3 calls content.hasNext before dispatching updated ID to static PRIMITIVE/COMPOSITE/CATEGORY. Exhaustion constructs YCoordMapIterator(4), returns YCOORDMAP while available, otherwise EOF; ID0 directly EOF, unknown logs/null. All recognized outputs are exact static Kind objects, satisfying converter reference comparisons. First getNextCategory returns content.getArrowCategory without calling next; subsequent typed getters cast content.next. Topology/map getters delegate; no call-order guards. close delegates superclass, statistics delegate content; premature statistics call can encounter null content. Synthetic accessors expose superclass preamble, initialized definitions and block stream. Content iterator and superclass remain unread: event decoding, ID transitions, and whether COMPOSITE can actually occur are unresolved, including converter lacking COMPOSITE branch.
